description: This file contains shell script tests for Git commands related to symbolic links, specifically testing the behavior of 'git update-index --add' with symlinks and files beyond symlinks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test expectation with a label and test commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures the following command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the expected output with the actual output.
